note: One row per PNG under tools/art-forge/out/env/ — art-forge's environment concept renders (the A1-ART-02 Millcross roll batch). The storybook's OWN registry for this artifact type, exactly as maps-index.json registers mapforge sheets and world-index.json registers the civil layer: the 2026-08-15 owner rule (every produced artifact must be observable in a review surface) made mechanical for env renders by tests/env-index.test.mjs, closing the gap the town-canon reviewer flagged in docs/worldbuilding/reviews/2026-08-30-millcross-dev-roll-verdict.md (open question 2: "Wire art-forge env renders into the storybook before the next roll"). seed/control/strength/briefHash are transcribed from tools/art-forge/runs/A1-ART-02.json render entries matched by output path (provenance "run-log"); rows the run log does not record carry provenance "filename" and briefHash null, with seed/strength taken from the filename itself. The renders are gitignored (tools/art-forge/.gitignore ignores out/), so the gate is existence-based: it enforces full parity wherever the renders exist and passes vacuously in a checkout without them. `reviews` links the verdict sheet that judged a render; an empty array is honest for the un-reviewed engineering probes (baseline sweeps, guard probes, anchor/segment experiments).
